UZ.inboundMetricLabel: Officially declared foreign-citizen arrivals for tourism purposes, by country
UZ.inboundScope: All individually identifiable countries and territories in SIAT annual series 2.04.11.0037
UZ.inboundNote: National Statistics Committee annual observations, updated 23 April 2026; original unit persons. The official tourism-purpose category covers more than leisure alone; counts are trips/declarations, not unique holidaymakers. Source records zero values for some markets. Historical/unspecified geographical categories are excluded from current-country ranks. No market share is calculated because this table does not supply an explicit national-total row.

KZ.label: Official 2025 travel flows with direction-specific definitions
KZ.inboundMetricLabel: Inbound visitor border crossings by citizenship
KZ.inboundScope: All individually identified country rows in annual BNS border-service workbook, first sheet, 2025 Total column
KZ.inboundNote: Source: Border Service of the National Security Committee, published by Kazakhstan Bureau of National Statistics. Visitors include business, private and tourism trips, excluding employment and permanent residence. Same-day crossings are included. Outbound country is the country of entry recorded at departure and does not enumerate an entire itinerary. First-sheet totals are used consistently; other workbook sheets contain small total revisions. Country labels and reported values are preserved, including very small markets.

AZ.inboundMetricLabel: Foreign arrivals for tourism purposes by country of residence
AZ.inboundScope: All named countries in State Statistical Committee annual bulletin Table 1; tourism-purpose count column
AZ.inboundNote: Annual 2025 bulletin published Baku 2026. Uses the explicitly reported tourism-purpose subset rather than all border arrivals/departures. Tourism purposes include several travel purposes, not only holidays; the all-purpose count is retained separately on each row. Other countries is excluded from named country ranks. Source table is alphabetic; displayed ranks sort the actual tourism-purpose counts.

GE.label: Official 2025 travel flows with direction-specific definitions
GE.inboundMetricLabel: International visitor trips by source country (GNTA top 15)
GE.inboundScope: The 15 leading country markets explicitly enumerated by GNTA; no claim of a full top 20
GE.inboundNote: GNTA Statistical Overview of Georgian Tourism 2025, pages 5–6. Counts international visitor trips, including overnight and same-day visits; distinct from all 7,803,239 traveller crossings and 5,521,866 overnight tourist trips. Source: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Information-analytical Department. The source chart provides 15 countries, so the list is intentionally limited to 15.

BT.label: Official 2025 travel flows with direction-specific definitions
BT.inboundMetricLabel: Tourist arrivals by nationality (official annual top 10)
BT.inboundScope: The 10 source markets enumerated in the Department of Tourism annual Top 10 Markets 2025 graphic; 157 nationalities were recorded overall
BT.inboundNote: Tashel Melong 2025, Department of Tourism / Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment; PDF page 5 (printed page 4), annual Top 10 Markets graphic. The graphic is a raster image; counts were transcribed after visual inspection at high resolution. National total on PDF page 4 and December 2025 bulletin agree at 209,376. Arrivals include non-SDF-paying tourists. This source only reports ten individual markets, so no top-20 claim is made.
